description: Source code for the UserPreferences plugin in the WPEFramework, managing UI language settings, migration, and notifications.

classes.name: UserPreferences
classes.description: Main class implementing user preferences management, including language conversion, migration, and notification handling.

classes.name: UserPreferences::Notification
classes.description: Nested class handling notifications related to user preferences changes, such as presentation language updates.

methods.name: ConvertToUserSettingsFormat
methods.description: Converts UI language string from 'US_en' format to 'en-US' format.

methods.name: ConvertToUserPrefsFormat
methods.description: Converts presentation language string from 'en-US' format to 'US_en' format.

methods.name: PerformMigration
methods.description: Handles migration of language settings between file storage and UserSettings interface.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, obtains UserSettings interface, and performs migration if needed.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: getUILanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the current UI language setting, registers for notifications, and updates local cache.

methods.name: setUILanguage
methods.description: Sets the UI language, updates UserSettings, and ensures synchronization with stored preferences.
